messages:
Nina CS: Heads-up — ElysianHealth (trial) asked for a scoped APAC/Japan allowlist + temporary QPS increase for a procurement demo next Friday 10:30 JST. They called this high impact for renewal; want it auto-revoked after 3 hours.

Ravi Ops: Can you post the org id and source CIDRs? Also do they need VPC peering or just edge allowlist?

Nina CS: Org: elysian-trial (EHL-09). They prefer edge allowlist + SNI passthrough. CIDRs below, TTL 2026-04-25T06:00Z. Endpoints: /v1/embeddings, /v1/rerank.

```
198.51.100.200/32
198.51.100.201/32
2001:db8:dead::/64
```

Marta Eng: Rerank and embeddings are token-light but throughput-sensitive. Recommend pin to `rwd-embed-1` for embeddings and `rwd-rank-1` for rerank routes. For hosted we should do a soft_qps=35 with hard cap 55 for safety. Also enable prefix KV warmup for rerank.

Leo SE: For SNI passthrough confirm they're using a custom proxy cert? If so we may need to coordinate with infra for TLS handshake inspection — otherwise edge allowlist suffices.

Nina CS: They're using CloudFront + custom cert. No peering requested. Just edge allowlist.

Ravi Ops: Opening ticket and applying to ap-northeast-1 edge. Setting soft_qps=35 hard_qps=55, auto-revoke at TTL. Ticket CS-4893 created.

deploy-bot: Ticket CS-4893 created by Ravi Ops — temp allowlist (ap-northeast-1) + soft_qps bump. https://redwood.ops/tickets/CS-4893

Marta Eng: Small note — because rerank tends to be bursty, we'll enable short-lived token throttles per-session and set a token ceiling to avoid noisy neighbours. Proposed token limit: 35000 tokens over window.

Leo SE: Approved. Ops — please add session token cap and pin models. Also add a monitoring alert: org=EHL-09, error_rate>2% or 95th latency >600ms.

Ravi Ops: Done. Applied allowlist, soft_qps=35 hard_qps=55, session_token_cap=35000, model pins for embeddings/rerank, auto_revoke=2026-04-25T06:00Z. Added monitors. Ticket CS-4893 updated.

deploy-bot: CS-4893 updated: allowlist active, soft_qps=35, hard_qps=55, token_cap=35000, auto_revoke=2026-04-25T06:00Z. Monitoring enabled.

Nina CS: Customer confirmed they see responses and latency looks good. I'll log a renewal follow-up and note the procurement demo outcome. Thanks all :tada:

Marta Eng: Added a short playbook snippet to the ticket:
```
Demo lift checklist:
1) collect org + CIDRs + TTL + endpoints
2) choose model pins and token caps
3) apply allowlist to region(s)
4) soft_qps bump + hard cap
5) enable KV warmup / session caps for bursty endpoints
6) set automated monitors and auto-revoke
7) CS reports demo outcome -> capture renewal motion
```

Leo SE: Great. Leaving this open until auto-revoke, will close after verification. Good luck to Elysian on the demo! :crossed_fingers:
